decision_scope: Provisional experimental keep based on observed score; final student selection remains pending, with relevance caveat below.

observations.e-009: Passed actual escalation-call check; reply refers to ticket 151 for the negative price.
observations.e-008: Passed escalation-call check and describes the store conflict, but a broader catalogue search found an unrelated negative price that was included in the ticket. The result does not isolate the trigger or establish that escalation was restricted to relevant evidence.
observations.e-006: Passed account-change escalation. The negative-price hook does not directly target account changes, so do not attribute this improvement to that hook without further evidence.
observations.response_detail: All four response-detail cases still failed their judge.

limitations: Single run per case; model/provider variation prevents strong causal or reliability conclusions.
Post-tool routing currently reacts to any negative-priced product returned by a search, including an incidental match. This is a known scope limitation, not proven absence of unnecessary escalation.

Saved result summaries omit complete tool-call lists; do not claim to have verified every ticket payload or exact forced-call sequence live. Offline SDK testing verified the sequence with scripted tools.
Batch was substantially slower than previous batches; recorded median agent latency rose, but provider delays versus harness effects cannot be separated.
No write_pass_5 value because supplied runner classifies these cases as non-write cases.
Held-out tests were not run and grading files remained frozen.
next_step: Part D GEPA preparation, with separate approval for paid search and continued reporting of target-case outcomes and the known scoring/harness limitations.
